prompts.text: Sparse felt piano and soft woodwinds, a light airy forest by the sea at midday, modern indie game score
Gentle flowing harp arpeggios like a stream over stones, bright and clear, minimalist
Airy ambient pads with distant sea, breathing slowly, pearl grey morning light

objects.name: Brackets and a rope with a weight

demo.means: which demonstration is on the table: only its things are seen (the others are not painted), a change is at once. none — an empty table; bellows and breath — the bellows; sockets — the peg and the sockets; bubbles — the bubbles and the same sockets; screw — one screw s1, screws — four; drum — one drum, drum2 — two

bell_hits.means: the bell: a counter of strikes (an integer, the game adds 1) — at each it swings and rings

drawer.means: which drawer slides out (changes at once)

drawer_open.means: how far the drawer named in drawer is out: 0 — pushed in, 1 — pulled out

door_knocks.means: the little door: a counter of knocks on it (an integer, +1 a touch) — the door trembles

door_reply.means: the little door: a counter of knocks back from inside (an integer, +1) — the door jolts harder, the strip of light under it flares

bellows.means: the bellows: 0 — empty, 1 — full (the top board with the handle rises)

lantern.means: the lantern: its fire from a spark (0) to full (1)

wind.means: a gust of wind: 0 — calm, 1 — strong (the lantern swings on its hook, the flame leans; the bell sways)

candle.means: the candle: its flame from small (0) to full (1)

candle_shake.means: the candle: 0 — the flame is steady, 1 — it trembles and thrashes

wick1.means: the first (left) wick: 0 — an even quiet flame, 1 — smoking: a tall sooty flame thrashes, smoke above it

wick2.means: the second (middle) wick: 0 — a quiet flame, 1 — smoking

wick3.means: the third (right) wick: 0 — a quiet flame, 1 — smoking

climb.means: the brackets: the weight on the rope between them rises: 0 — at the bottom, 1 — at the top

grip.means: the brackets: which one holds now — it lightens (changes at once, lightens in a fraction of a second)

rope.means: the weight to the hook: 0 — the weight in its place (the point rope#weight), 1 — its loop on the hook (rope#hook); it goes in a straight line, the point rope#weight with it

shutter.means: the shutter: 0 — down, 1 — raised to the mark (the handle shutter#handle at the point shutter#top)

crate.means: the heavy crate: 0 — in its place, 1 — on the chalk outline to the right (crate#goal); the handle crate#handle moves with it

knot.means: the knot: 0 — tight, 1 — loose (bigger loops, the rope sags)

knot_off.means: the knot has come apart: both halves of the rope hang from the posts

peg.means: the peg (changes at once): none — lies on the table to the left, held — in hand: painted under the finger, at the point peg_u, peg_v; sN — stands in the socket sN. The point sockets#peg is where it is painted now

peg_u.means: the peg in hand (peg = held): where it is along the board — 0 at sockets#s1, 1 at sockets#s3 (may go beyond 0..1)

peg_v.means: the peg in hand: where it is up from the line s1→s3, in lengths |s1→s3| (down — below 0); the board and the peg are on one upright card facing the camera

bubble1.means: the first bubble: free — floats round its circle (let go, it floats on from there, slowly coming back to the circle), held — in hand: painted under the finger, at the point bubble1_u, bubble1_v; sN — sits in the socket sN. The point bubbles#b1 is where it is painted

bubble1_u.means: bubble 1 in hand: along the board with the sockets — 0 at sockets#s1, 1 at sockets#s3

bubble1_v.means: bubble 1 in hand: up from the line s1→s3, in lengths |s1→s3|

bubble2.means: the second bubble: free — floats round its circle (let go, it floats on from there, slowly coming back to the circle), held — in hand: painted under the finger, at the point bubble2_u, bubble2_v; sN — sits in the socket sN. The point bubbles#b2 is where it is painted

bubble2_u.means: bubble 2 in hand: along the board with the sockets — 0 at sockets#s1, 1 at sockets#s3

bubble2_v.means: bubble 2 in hand: up from the line s1→s3, in lengths |s1→s3|

bubble3.means: the third bubble: free — floats round its circle (let go, it floats on from there, slowly coming back to the circle), held — in hand: painted under the finger, at the point bubble3_u, bubble3_v; sN — sits in the socket sN. The point bubbles#b3 is where it is painted

bubble3_u.means: bubble 3 in hand: along the board with the sockets — 0 at sockets#s1, 1 at sockets#s3

bubble3_v.means: bubble 3 in hand: up from the line s1→s3, in lengths |s1→s3|

crack.means: the crack: the glue fills it from the left end (p0) to the right (p6): 0 — no glue, 1 — filled all through

screw1.means: the screw s1: 0 — out, 1 — driven home (the slot turned two turns, the head seated)

plate.means: the dusty plaque: 0 — all in dust, 1 — the dust wiped off, the word “Workshop” and a little ship are seen (the dust comes off in patches)

floor_found.means: the floorboards: the board over the hiding place (floor#hidden) is moved aside, a key is seen in the hollow

shell.means: the shell touched (changes at once): it rocks, and “the odd one” (shell_odd) glows. It answers a change of the value: a second touch of the same one goes through none

shell_odd.means: which shell is “the odd one”: at a touch it glows instead of rocking

shell_found.means: “the odd one” is found: it has opened, a pearl in it

drum_hits.means: the drum (drum): a counter of hits (an integer, +1) — the skin jumps

drum2_hits.means: the second drum (drum2): a counter of hits (an integer, +1)

boat_heading.means: the boat: where the bow points on the scale: −1 — the scale's left end (−60°), 0 — the middle, 1 — the right end

zone_center.means: the boat: where the zone (or the firefly, or the bumblebee) is on the scale: −1 — the left end, 1 — the right

zone_kind.means: what is on the scale at zone_center: zone — a light band on the scale, firefly — a firefly over the scale, bee — a bumblebee over the scale

zone_lit.means: the boat: the zone (the firefly) glows brighter — the bow is in it: 0 — no, 1 — yes

sand.means: the hourglass: 0 — all the sand on top, 1 — run through; while the key moves, a trickle is seen
